title: does anyone dream of the labyrinth house?
content: For years I've dreamt of a house that has shifting architecture that makes no sense. Staircases leading nowhere, hallways that you have to crawl through, traveling through the inside of the walls, crawling under the floorboards, climbing down through shower drains, etc. Inside there are pieces of other buildings, usually a school and a hospital. There's classrooms, and bathrooms that are always empty with leaking exposed pipes that drive me mad, hospital beds and an echoing cough though I never find out who is making it. There's always the sounds of people in these dreams but I never see them. And in these dreams there's always an urgency to leave, like I know something is chasing me though I never see it, only hear it. In my mind I have a map, but as I rush through the twisting halls that shift in size I realize my map is no good, and the panic sets in and I run blindly. I always manage to escape, and when I turn to look, it's only a simple two story house on the outside despite being infinite inside. I feel such relief that I escaped, but every time there is something I've forgotten, or someone, and I make my way back, but I wake up the moment my hand touches the doorknob. Am I the only one who has this place in their dreams?
